name: University of Notre Dame
academic_ranking: Nationally ranked private Catholic research university; consistently ranked among the top ~20 national universities (e.g., #12 per College Consensus 2025) and a member of the Association of American Universities (AAU).
financial_aid: Notre Dame meets 100% of every admitted student's demonstrated financial need and offers 'No Loan' aid packages. Over 70% of undergraduates receive some form of financial aid. Under the new Pathways to Notre Dame program (2026-27), families earning up to $150,000 pay $0 tuition and families up to $200,000 receive aid covering at least half tuition. Athletic scholarships are limited by NCAA D1 softball rules.
facilities_notes: Home games are played at Melissa Cook Stadium on the Notre Dame campus (capacity ~1,250 spectators), the dedicated softball facility for the Fighting Irish.
program_reputation: NCAA Division I program competing in the Atlantic Coast Conference. Strong combination of athletic and academic performance - nine Irish earned ACC All-Academic Team honors in 2026, and players earned All-ACC and NFCA All-Region recognition. Currently rebuilding under head coach Kris Ganeff, competed in the 2026 ACC Softball Championships.
notes: Softball staff/coaches sourced from the Notre Dame athletics staff directory (fightingirish.com), checked 2026-07. The dedicated softball coaches page (fightingirish.com/sports/softball/coaches) returned HTTP 502 during research; staff data obtained from the athletics staff directory. Roster size (20) from the 2025-26 softball roster page. No individual coach Twitter/X handles were publicly listed; team account is @NDsoftball. Exact tuition and softball scholarship count could not be confirmed from a primary source and are left null to avoid guessing.
